name: Collection/Gacha Reward
summary: Correct answers unlock randomized reward reveals with rarity tiers (common, rare, epic, legendary), creating excitement through luck-based collection mechanics.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates questions and reward metadata excellently. Pre-built game shells (chest opens, fishing animation). AI fills reward pools with thematic items. Rarity weighting and probability calculations are deterministic.

questionMechanic.description: ID of the wrapped question mechanic (e.g., 'multiple-choice', 'true-false').

questions.description: Array of question objects conforming to the wrapped mechanic's schema.

rarityTiers.description: Array of rarity tier definitions. Each tier has: name (string), probability (float 0-1), color (hex), items (string[], 3-8 possible items), animation (e.g., 'sparkle', 'burst').

questionsToUnlock.description: Number of consecutive correct answers needed to unlock one reward reveal (typical 1-3).

rewardPool.description: Complete list of possible items across all tiers, with rarity assignment and metadata.

duplicateHandling.description: What happens when a learner gets a duplicate reward.

showcaseEnabled.description: Whether learners can view and share their collection (optional gallery feature).

ux.mobileNotes: Question at top (40%). Large reward-reveal button (e.g., treasure chest, fish hook) occupies center. Tap to answer, tap chest to reveal. Rarity animations: common items fade in, rare items sparkle/burst. Collection counter/preview at bottom (sticky). Option to view full collection overlay.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Simple 3-tier rarity (common, rare, legendary). Cute reward items (animals, plants, toys). Unlocked after every correct answer. No trading. Basic collection view.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 4-5 rarity tiers with skill-based probability (harder questions = better drops). Thematic item sets. Unlock after 2 correct answers. Track duplicate counts (badge notifications).
ageAdaptations.14-16: 6+ rarity tiers with weighted probabilities. Themed item variants (e.g., 'Ancient Egypt' collection). Trading system: exchange duplicates for currency/crafting. Full collection showcase with rarity percentages and trading leaderboard.
